clients.name: Identity Access Management System
clients.description: The default client used by the `iams-web`, which is the web GUI to provide user and access control configuration by hitting the `iams-aas` service.

clients.name: Web Base
clients.description: Change this client to suit your project. Most projects would likely only have 1 web base, or 2 if they segregate operational and administrative servers.

clients.name: Unified Notification Hub Module
clients.description: Service identity unh-service uses to read IAMS when resolving distribution-list members. Deliberately separate from sds: its service account carries view-users + view-clients only, with no manage-users.

clients.name: Push Token Manager
clients.description: The mobile application server for managing FCM token lifecycle.

clients.name: In-app Notifications
clients.description: The application in-charge of sending in-app notifications to the user.

clientScopes.description: The default scope to add the "all_tenants" and "active_tenant" claims to the client.
